criteria_considered: LOCAL_TEST_MODE loopback application and database hosts and absence of Alpaca/OpenRouter credentials
bounded strict snapshot JSON and database size with fixture/cursor semantic validation
parameterized SQL and append-only migration history
no provider client, trading route, or secret exposure
evidence: src/domain/config.ts requires a loopback bind host and loopback DATABASE_URL hostname when localTestMode is true, and rejects Alpaca key ID/secret and OpenRouter API key in that mode.

src/infra/local-runtime-snapshot.ts parses a strict versioned object shape, bounds market state to 100 entries and fields to constrained formats/lengths, verifies row identity/version, limits serialized snapshot bytes to 262144 UTF-8 bytes, and binds SELECT/INSERT values as PostgreSQL parameters.

src/domain/market-state.ts bounds restored cursor to fixture length and recomputes expected market state from fixture events up to that cursor; it rejects inconsistent symbols, feed, source timestamp, trade, or quote state before accepting restoration.

migrations/0005_bound_local_runtime_snapshots.sql enforces octet_length(snapshot::text) <= 262144 at the database layer. Existing migrations 0001 through 0004 match the exact candidate manifest SHA-256 values; migration 0005 adds the constraint without rewriting prior history.

src/api/app.ts registers health/status and fixture-backed local controls only when localTestMode is enabled; source scan found no outbound provider client or order-submission route. The PAPER invariant is asserted at startup. Public config omits database and credential values, startup/config errors are generic, and local traces/logs retain route templates and bounded metadata rather than query, body, or header data.
Relevant audited file hashes match the dbb16 candidate manifest, including app/config/runtime restore/replay/migration sources and all five migration files.
limitations: Static source and manifest review only; no tests, live database, or provider connectivity checks were run.
